tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250gu ru chos dbang gi zab gter las byon pa'i ma ning gi rgyun gtor sogs bzhugs so// 1$0000300hūm̐: dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: tshur gshegs tshur gshegs lha chen po: ma hā kā la mthu bo che: gsang ba'i khro rgyal stobs po che: 'chol ba'i khro rgyal dgra bgegs gshed: ma ning nag po kun gyi rje: 'og min gnas mchog dam pa dang: gsang chen lhun grub gtsug lag khang: dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal yas nas: mchod phyir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: lha chen dpal 'bar gshegs su gsol: legs ldan nag po gshegs su gsol: tshogs bdag nag po gshegs= bha ga nag po gshegs= srog bdud chen po gshegs= dzaṃ lha nag po gshegs= nag po tshe bdud gshegs= bya rgod thang nag gshegs= nag po thod phreng gshegs= mkha' lding nag po gshegs= ṭā ki nag po gshegs= klu bdud nag po gshegs= gza' bdud nag po gshegs= sha ging nag po gshegs= yab rje nag po gshegs= dgra gshed nag po gshegs= bgegs kyi gnyen po gshegs= bdag gi grogs po gshegs= dam can chen po gshegs= chos skyong chen po gshegs= 'gro ba kun bzang gshegs= bdud kyi dmag tshogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: ye shes mgon po 'khor dang bcas: bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol: oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wān shrī ma hā kā la ga ṇa gu h+ya sa ma ya dza dza:

zhes spyan drangs la/ de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal yas dam pa 'dir: dregs pa ru dra bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: nyi zla pad+ma brtsegs pa'i gdan la ni: ma ning 'khor bcas dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs: shrī ma hā kā la ga ṇa gu h+ya sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: dug gsum rtsad gcod sku gsum lhun grub pa: phyi nang gsang gsum dgra bgegs thal bar rlog: dus gsum sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung mdzad pa'i: ma ning mched gsum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: a ti pū ho: ces phyag bya/ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: khyed la mchod pa dam pa 'bul ba ni: thod chen bhan+dha rlon pa'i snod nang du: bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa brengs se breng: rak+ta dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ chi li li: ba liṃ gtor ma'i mchod pa rongs se rong: sha chen gsur dud ngad pa chi li li: bhan+dha rus pa'i tshogs kyang khro lo lo: zhun chen mar me snang gsal ta la la: 'bru bcud dza gad gser skyems sbrengs se sbreng: zhal zas tshogs kyi longs spyod spungs se spung: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs: 'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa dam pa 'dis: dpal mgon ma ning nag po'i thugs dam bskang: lha chen dpal 'bar mched kyi= ye shes mgon po mched kyi thugs= sku yi mgon po stag zhon= gsung gi mgon po bing 'dzin= thugs kyi mgon po gri gug= yon tan mgon po seng zhon= phrin las mgon po trag shad thugs= dpal ldan re ma ti yi= 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam skong gyur cig: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ga ṇa gu h+ya raṃ sid+dhi hūm̐ phaṭa: rū pa tri yaṃ dza: rak+sha du bing ni dzaḥ ru ru k+ṣa tra ha na singha raṃ trag shad dza: trag rā dza bh+rūm̐ dza: i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes pas mchod pa phul nas bstod pa bya ba ni/ hūm̐: 'jig rten 'das pa'i dus na sngon byung ba: che mchog he ru ka dpal sku gsum rdzogs:

srid rtsa'i bdag 'dzin ru dra sde gsum 'dul: rtsal chen phrin las rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dpal chen dngos sprul nag po chen po'i sku: 'chol ba'i khro rgyal ma ning dgra bgegs gshed: lha chen dpal 'bar chos skyong yongs kyi rje: dmag dpon chen po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dur khrod thod mkhar me rlung 'tshub dkyil na: rnal 'byor dpal mgon khyod kyi cha lugs ni: sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: sku gsum ldan phyir spyan gsum gyen thur gzigs: rab 'jigs khro gnyer gsum ldan gtum la rngam: zhal gdang mche gtsigs drag po'i rkan sgra rdeb: rin chen thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan: sbrul nag ral pa nag pos sa gzhi khyab: g.yas pa ru mtshon g.yon pa snying zhags bsnams: tsan+dan bing chen sked btsug lha dmag 'gyed: thod pa skam rlon snying phreng sbrul chun spras: dar nag ber gsol gser sked mi lpags bcings: las la chas tshe srog bdud cha lugs 'dzin: srid gsum gzigs phyir spyan gsum brang la shar: dmag dpon bzhi 'gyed spyan bzhis lhu tshigs brgyan: stag ral gzig shub btags nas rta nag zhon: bdud mdas dgra snying gzir 'debs gling bzhir rgyug: spyan nas khrag 'dzag me yi kha rlangs 'bar: kha ṭ+wāṃ gri gug lcags par thogs nas ni: snang srid pho rgyud thams cad las la 'gyed: ci bcol las rnams skad cig yud la sgrub: rtag tu grogs mdzad mgon po nag po che: ma bskul par yang gnag pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: ltag na spyan gcig ma tshogs dbang du sdud: gar bskul sa ru mi ro'i tshar ma tshir: bzlog pas mi zlog sngags zlog mkhan gyi gshed: sde brgyad bran skul stag sham mig brgyad brgyan: gtsug lag khang srung dkor rkun rtsad nas gcod: dregs pa kun 'dul khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod:

༈ mkha' ri'i gsol kha ni/ jo chen mched bzhi 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs: phyi nang gsang ba mchog gi mchod pa dang: dpag yas rdzu 'phrul mnga' la yongs su bstod: bcol ba'i phrin las ma lus 'grub par mdzod: ces pa'am yang na oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs te/ gzhan yang dge bsnyen chen po she'u mkha' ri/ lcam shel sman gyi mthu bo che/ gcung po khu reng sogs dang gnam skas can gyi jo bo klu bdud mgo dgu /klu mo byang chub sman/ dge bsnyen smyon kha sogs gter khag gter srung rnams la 'bul lo/ dam chos bsgrub pa la bar gcod mi 'byung zhing phrin las thams cad sgrubs shig / ces bsngos pas 'thus par khyab bdag sman lung pas gsungs/ ༈ chos dbang rin po che'i gter srung spyi gsol gsung rgyun ma dge / dge bsnyen she'u mkha' ri dang*// jo bo klu bdud mgo dgu dang*// smyon kha nag po ti pa tsa// gter srung tshogs rnams gnas 'dir byon// mnyes mchod 'dod yon gtor ma'i tshogs// mthun pa'i dam rdzas tshogs kyis mchod// nyams chag 'gal 'khrul ci mchis bshags// thugs dam bskang la dngos grub stsol/ de ba nā ga sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da 'i bar dang*/ pañca rak+ta ba lin+ta khā hi/ dge legs 'phel/// /
